originality.rationale: Eight actual published-finding corpus semantic queries and historical claims were compared on exact statements/implications. Hou–Sun proves one-coordinate restricted sum results, Mockenhaupt–Tao analytic parabola restriction estimates, Shparlinski multiplicative-subgroup additive decomposition; none entails the full two-moment, collision-free, all-modulus fiber formula. Closest published-finding corpus publications concern Fourier norms or spectral sets rather than restricted triple representations. Standard conic counting/Hensel ingredients are acknowledged, and possible unlocated equivalent results remain a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Historical priority could be affected by unindexed work on restricted moment-curve convolutions or local quadratic representation densities with forbidden diagonal lines.
The most relevant newer parabola Fourier-norm publication was available as a published-finding corpus summary only; full text could not be inspected.
Semantic database retrieval is not exhaustive and cannot certify uniqueness.
